title: Optimistic Update Pattern — React Examples
title_es: Patrón Optimistic Update — Ejemplos en React
description: Runnable optimistic-update examples: like button with rollback, todo list with temp IDs, React 19 useOptimistic, React Query onMutate/onError/onSettled, a generic useOptimisticState hook, and versioned conflict handling.
description_es: Ejemplos ejecutables de optimistic update: botón de like con rollback, lista de tareas con IDs temporales, useOptimistic de React 19, onMutate/onError/onSettled de React Query, un hook genérico useOptimisticState y manejo de conflictos con versionado.
